sn: Use any combination of breasts and/or legs, or a whole chicken cut into pieces. In Jamaica the pieces are usually chopped through the bone into smaller pieces; at the least, separate drumsticks and thighs at the joint and cut the breast into 2 pieces, one with the wing attached. Ground cumin, coriander seed and garam masala are added to the Jamaican curry powder for extra depth; they are not required (many Jamaican cooks would not add them), so omit them if you like. Potatoes and carrots are added by some cooks in Jamaica and not by others; they are optional. Coconut milk is not in many Jamaican curry chicken recipes, but it makes a delicate yet rich gravy with deeper flavour.

Použite ľubovoľnú kombináciu pŕs a/alebo stehien alebo celé kurča rozporciované na kusy. Mletá rasca rímska, koriandrové semienko a garam masala sa pridávajú k jamajskému kari kvôli plnšej chuti; nie sú nutné (mnohí jamajskí kuchári ich nepridávajú), takže ich pokojne vynechajte. Zemiaky a mrkvu niektorí kuchári na Jamajke pridávajú a iní nie; sú nepovinné. Kokosové mlieko nie je v mnohých jamajských receptoch na kuracie kari, ale vytvorí jemnú, a pritom bohatú omáčku s plnšou chuťou.

sn: Calamansi is hard to find fresh; frozen calamansi juice from an Asian or Filipino market tastes better than bottled. Without calamansi, mix 1 part fresh lemon juice, 1/2 part fresh lime juice and 1/4 part granulated sugar (by volume). Light or dark brown sugar can replace the dark muscovado sugar. Vegetable or canola oil, or schmaltz, can be used instead of coconut oil. Spiced coconut vinegar (sinamak; the extra-spicy version is sold as pinakurat) is sold in Asian markets and online. Cane vinegar or distilled white vinegar are acceptable substitutes.

Čerstvé kalamansi sa ťažko zháňa; mrazená kalamansiová šťava z ázijského alebo filipínskeho obchodu chutí lepšie ako fľašková. Bez kalamansi zmiešajte 1 diel čerstvej citrónovej šťavy, 1/2 dielu čerstvej limetkovej šťavy a 1/4 dielu kryštálového cukru (podľa objemu). Tmavý muscovado cukor môžete nahradiť svetlým alebo tmavým hnedým cukrom. Namiesto kokosového oleja môžete použiť rastlinný alebo repkový olej, prípadne kurciu masť (schmaltz). Korenený kokosový ocot (sinamak; extra pálivá verzia sa predáva ako pinakurat) dostanete v ázijských obchodoch a online. Ako náhrada poslúži trstinový ocot alebo biely destilovaný ocot.

r.sr: Serious Eats — J. Kenji López-Alt — "Spicy Grilled Jerk Chicken"
sn: Scotch bonnet peppers are extremely hot: consider wearing gloves, wash the knife, board and surfaces right after, and do not touch your face until you have scrubbed your hands. Habaneros can be substituted; a mix of ripe and unripe chillies adds flavour. To split the chicken, cut out the backbone along both sides with poultry shears, turn the bird over and press it slightly flat, then cut it in half through the centre of the breastbone (or ask your butcher). 4 chicken leg quarters can be used instead. To double the recipe, use twice the chicken but the same amount of marinade, and grill all 4 halves at once.

Papričky Scotch bonnet sú mimoriadne pálivé: zvážte rukavice, nôž, dosku a povrchy hneď potom umyte a nedotýkajte sa tváre, kým si dôkladne neumyjete ruky. Môžete ich nahradiť habanero; zmes zrelých a nezrelých papričiek pridá chuť. Kurča rozdelíte tak, že hydinovými nožnicami vystrihnete chrbticu po oboch stranách, kurča otočíte, zľahka ho stlačíte naplocho a potom ho ostrým nožom prekrojíte na polovice cez stred hrudnej kosti (alebo požiadajte mäsiara). Namiesto neho môžete použiť 4 celé kuracie stehná. Pri dvojnásobnej dávke použite dvakrát viac kuraťa, ale rovnaké množstvo marinády, a všetky 4 polovice grilujte naraz.

sn: The braising times given are enough for a well-integrated fesenjan, but simmering it covered over very low heat for up to 1 hour longer does no harm. Fresh pomegranate arils on top are purely decorative and may be omitted. It is served family-style: everyone spoons rice (chelow) onto their plate and tops it with the braise. Making chelow also gives tahdig, the crispy rice from the bottom of the pot (both have their own recipes on Serious Eats).

Čerstvé zrnká granátového jablka navrchu sú len ozdoba a môžete ich vynechať. Podáva sa spoločne na stôl: každý si naberie na tanier ryžu (čelou) a prelije ju dusenou zmesou. Pri príprave čelou vznikne aj tahdig, chrumkavá ryža zo dna hrnca (obe majú na Serious Eats vlastné recepty).

sn: The traditional cut is a triangular, fairly lean cut from the rump with a fat cap on one side. Picanha (top sirloin cap) or top round, ideally with a fat cap, can replace it; failing that, any large boneless braising roast, including chuck, works. In a pressure cooker the time depends more on thickness than weight: a roast about 7.5 cm thick is usually tender after 30 minutes at high pressure. If it needs more, finish it by gentle simmering in the open cooker rather than re-pressurising. For a deeper broth, char the cut sides of the onion halves almost black in the dry pot before adding the beef and water. If the kaiser rolls are not stale, dice them, spread them on a rimmed baking sheet…

V tlakovom hrnci závisí čas viac od hrúbky ako od hmotnosti: kus hrubý asi 7,5 cm je zvyčajne mäkký po 30 minútach pri vysokom tlaku. Pre plnší vývar opečte rezné strany polovíc cibule v suchom hrnci takmer dočierna ešte pred pridaním mäsa a vody. Ak žemle nie sú staré, nakrájajte ich na kocky, rozložte na plech s okrajom a vysušte v rúre pri…

sn: Book tripe (not honeycomb) can replace the oxtails: rinse it under cold water, boil it in salted water for 10 minutes, drain, rinse again, then add it in step 4 and simmer until tender with a slight chew, 1 to 2 hours. Avoid commercial peanut butter with added sugar; its sweetness does not suit the dish. Ginisang bagoong is fermented shrimp paste sautéed with onion, garlic, vinegar and sugar; it is sold in Filipino or Asian markets and online. In a pressure cooker or multicooker, sear the oxtails and sauté the aromatics in it, return the oxtails, fill with water to the max line and cook at high pressure for 1 hour 15 minutes; it saves time but gives less broth. sn: Do not trim fat or sinew from the meat; it adds flavour and richness and breaks down completely. In a pressure cooker add only 235 ml water (not the 475 ml of the stovetop version); on the stovetop, stir more often after the first hour to prevent sticking and scorching. Aleppo pepper is quite mild, with a raisin-like sweetness; it is sold in Middle Eastern markets and online. Gochugaru, or paprika plus 1/8 tsp cayenne, can be substituted.

sn: Instead of finnan haddie you can cold-smoke any lean white fish (haddock, cod, halibut) at home. Brine: dissolve 60 g salt, 30 g sugar, 2 bay leaves and 15 black peppercorns in 500 ml water over high heat, take off the heat and add 1500 ml cold water (or 500 g ice). When fully cool, soak the fish in it in the refrigerator for 1 hour, then set it on a rack over a rimmed baking sheet at room temperature, uncovered, for 1 to 2 hours. Then refrigerate it uncovered for at least 1 and up to 24 hours. Smoke it in a cold smoker with cherry or other wood for about 4 hours; or put it in a zip-top bag, fill the bag with smoke from a smoking gun, seal and refrigerate for 30 minutes, and repeat for 5 or…

Potom ju nechajte odokrytú v chladničke aspoň 1 a najviac 24 hodín. Údte ju v udiarni na studený dym s čerešňovým alebo iným drevom asi 4 hodiny; alebo ju vložte do uzatvárateľného vrecka, naplňte ho dymom z udiacej pištole,…

r.sr: Serious Eats (J. Kenji López-Alt) — "Osaka-Style Okonomiyaki"
sn: This is a simple base: you can add diced shrimp, corn kernels or other shredded or chopped vegetables, keeping the extras under 225 g in total. Beni-shoga (red pickled ginger) can be omitted or replaced with chopped sushi ginger. Katsuobushi (dried, smoked, shaved bonito) should be the fine shavings; it can be omitted. Yamaimo (Japanese mountain yam) can be omitted. Hondashi is granulated dashi; water can replace it. Ao-nori is powdered green seaweed (or use finely shredded nori). Okonomiyaki sauce is sweet-savoury (Bull-Dog sauce, or equal parts Worcestershire sauce and ketchup seasoned with soy sauce, can replace it). Kewpie is a sweet Japanese mayonnaise (regular mayonnaise works). All…

Toto je jednoduchý základ: môžete pridať nakrájané krevety, kukuričné zrná alebo inú nastrúhanú či nakrájanú zeleninu, spolu do 225 g. Beni-šóga (červený nakladaný zázvor) môžete vynechať alebo nahradiť nasekaným zázvorom k sushi. Kacuobuši (sušené, údené, hobľované bonito) použite v jemných hoblinách; môžete ho vynechať. Jamaimo (japonský horský jam) môžete vynechať. Hondaši je granulovaný daši; nahradiť ho môže voda. Ao-nori je práškovaná zelená morská riasa (alebo použite jemne nastrihané nori). The dish can be prepared through step 5, covered with baking paper, wrapped in foil and refrigerated for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 1 month (thaw in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 days). To bake, remove the paper, replace the foil and increase the baking time to 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

Najlepšie sú lasagne bez predvárania Barilla pre jemnú textúru podobnú čerstvým cestovinám; niektoré značky majú v balení len 12 plátov a recept potrebuje 16. Jedlo môžete pripraviť po krok 5, prikryť papierom na pečenie, zabaliť do alobalu a uchovať v chladničke najviac 3 dni alebo zamraziť najviac na 1 mesiac (rozmrazujte v chladničke 1 až 2 dni). Pred pečením papier odstráňte, alobal vráťte a čas pečenia predĺžte na 1 až 1 1/4 hodiny.

sn: Vary the vegetables to taste or season, but keep at least the onion (or leek), garlic, carrots and celery. Lacinato kale is also sold as cavolo nero or black kale. Canned or home-cooked beans both work (dried, cooked with aromatics, taste best). 2 cans (425 g each) give a little more than needed; about 150 g dried beans gives about 590 ml cooked.

sn: The recipe doubles or triples easily. sn: The za'atar plant is hard to find; oregano is the best substitute, ideally fresh leaves dried at home. Marjoram and/or thyme can be mixed in, about 3 parts oregano to 1 part marjoram and/or thyme. 45 g dried leaves need 250 to 300 g fresh oregano leaves (500 to 700 g with stems). Check the fresh leaves are not unpleasantly bitter, then dry the stems on towel-lined baking sheets in a clean, airy place (a few days to 2 weeks), or in a dehydrator at 38 °C for about 36 hours, until a leaf crumbles easily; rub the leaves off the stems.

Bring 1920 ml water with it to a boil in a large enamelled pot, then keep at a gentle simmer, covered; set a bowl of 945 ml cold water nearby. Wearing gloves, dip each pretzel bottom side up in the soda bath for 30 to 40 seconds, then in the cold water for 30 to 40 seconds, and set it on a rack. sn: Without an ice cream maker: put the syrup and rose water in a shallow 2000 ml container, cover and freeze until ice crystals form, about 4 hours (cook the noodles meanwhile). Unlike ice cream, fāloodeh can be refrozen; store it in a wide, flat airtight plastic container rather than glass or ceramic. Mung bean noodles come in 30 to 50 g bundles; use the thinnest you can find (Asian shops or the world-food aisle). The strand wrapped around a bundle unwraps itself as the water heats.
